q: 在一致性与可用性之间应该怎么选？

牺牲分区容忍来换两者兼得

Favor strong consistency, rejecting requests rather than returning stale data.
Make both reads and writes linearizable.
Give up partition tolerance to get both at once.
optionMeanings: 系统尽量保持能响应，容忍短暂陈旧。
系统尽量保证读到最新值，代价是可能拒绝请求。
最强的一致性模型，读写全局有序。
分布式系统里通常不可放弃分区容忍。
optionMeanings_en: The system stays responsive and tolerates brief staleness.
The system prioritizes fresh reads at the cost of possibly rejecting requests.
The strongest consistency model, with globally ordered reads and writes.
